# sudhanva JavaScript SDK, CLI, and Homebrew tap

> The official source, GitHub Packages package, and Homebrew tap for the sudhanva.me
> JavaScript and TypeScript SDK and command-line interface.

## Install

- Library: `npm install @nsudhanva/sudhanva` from GitHub Packages, then `import { Client } from '@nsudhanva/sudhanva'`
- GitHub Packages needs `.npmrc` lines `@nsudhanva:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com` and `//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=${GITHUB_TOKEN}`, with a token that has `read:packages`
- Command without a token: https://sudhanva.me/developers/cli/ (archive on the site)
- Command: `brew install nsudhanva/sudhanva/sudhanva`
- Command from GitHub Packages: `npm install --global @nsudhanva/sudhanva`
- Formula: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/blob/main/Formula/sudhanva.rb
- Library source: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/blob/main/cli/index.js
- Library types: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/blob/main/cli/index.d.ts
- CLI source: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/blob/main/cli/sudhanva.mjs
- Release verification: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/blob/main/scripts/verify-release.mjs

## Contracts

- SDK documentation: https://sudhanva.me/developers/sdks/
- CLI documentation: https://sudhanva.me/developers/cli/
- Versioning policy: https://sudhanva.me/developers/versioning/
- GitHub Packages package: https://github.com/nsudhanva/homebrew-sudhanva/pkgs/npm/sudhanva
- API documentation: https://sudhanva.me/docs/
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://sudhanva.me/openapi.json
- Profile-insights API: https://sudhanva.me/docs/profile-insights/
- Versioned archive: https://sudhanva.me/cli/sudhanva-0.2.0.tgz
- License: MIT

The library and the CLI do not need credentials. They return JSON. Retrieval commands use
HTTPS GET. The insight command creates and polls an idempotent job that lasts 24 hours. The
job uses only published site evidence. Homebrew test-bot checks changes to the formula.
